capabilities: Track works through idea-to-archived stages on a drag-and-drop board
Schedule and reschedule publications on a built-in calendar
Initialize linked pages, templates and Bases views in a chosen folder
Record monthly goals and work metrics in review notes
Sync publication schedules one-way to an iCloud CalDAV calendar
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool; it does not post to content platforms or fetch platform analytics, and only records metrics you enter yourself.
extras: Interface language is Chinese only. Not yet in the community directory; must be installed manually from a GitHub release. Includes detailed privacy and network disclosure for the optional calendar sync; no paid features or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for managing a content-creation pipeline from idea to publication and performance review.

relations.evidence: Full Calendar can separately display the same iCloud calendar.
The six-section workflow was inspired by Xuan子's creator dashboard explanation.

summary: Six-view creation pipeline that tracks works as Markdown notes through idea, production, publication calendar and review stages, with optional iCloud sync.
